newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European bunkers - ARA gains draw in buyers.
newsitem.headline: European bunkers - ARA gains draw in buyers.

text.p: European bunkers were mixed on Thursday and business was slight in most parts, but small prices rises in ARA drew in buyers, dealers said.

Rotterdam 380 CST traded in the range $119-$121 delivered late in response to barge price increases. Bunker trade was reasonable with two early large enquiries pushing volume beyond 10,000 tonnes in ARA, dealers said.
"A number of people waited yesterday and the prices edged up. They had to buy today," one supplier said.
Hamburg was closed because of a public holiday in Germany.
South French ports were about $1 a tonne lower, but quiet.
In Spain, activity picked up while prices were marginally higher.
"People may have noticed prices on the screen going up again, so they were forced to buy now," one supplier said.
Fujairah bunkers were steady, but still firm at $113-$116.
Durban prices were steady, with no supply problems and stocks restored to healthy levels.
